caption: The drawing consists of abstract and geometric shapes in black, red, and white on a light brown, textured background. The central composition features a large, figure-like form on the right with two upright horns or points on its head, circular motifs near the shoulders, and raised arms. The body of this figure is filled with zigzag and linear patterns, with its lower part composed of blocky limbs and oval joints. To the left of this figure, there is a smaller skeleton-like form in red and black, oriented diagonally with a series of vertebrae and limbs extending outward. Multiple circular and spiral motifs appear across the composition, particularly in the middle and left sections, some featuring concentric rings and central points or arrows. There are additional abstract small forms and lines scattered, with some fine details like dots and crosses. The left and bottom edges have jagged, zigzag borders in red and white. The overall style is non-representational, with an emphasis on repeating shapes and contrasting colors.
title: Petroglyphs
